simple.meaning: נָפִישׁ (Nâphîysh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Naphish , a son of Ishmael, and his posterity.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נָפִישׁ (H5305) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 25:15, with occurrences in Genesis, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָפִישׁ (H5305) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נָפִישׁ (H5305) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נָפִישׁ (Nâphîysh) / H5305 is traced through Genesis 25:15, 1 Chronicles 1:31, 1 Chronicles 5:19 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: Naphish , a son of Ishmael, and his posterity
definitions.full: H5305. Naphish נָפִישׁ proper name, masculine son of Ishmael, according to Gen 25:15 (P), = 1Chr 1:31 ( ᵐ5 Ναφες , ᵐ5 L Ναφεις ); = (Arab) tribe 5:19 ( ᵐ5 Ναφεισαδαιων , A ᵐ5 L Ναφισαιων ). נֶ֫פֶת see II. נוף .

occurrences.englishText: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
